steps.observable_result: The Stage Agent has read the portable package and all four current materials, then selected the next pending or in-progress task.
RED evidence demonstrates the intended behavioral change, or tasks.md records why RED is not applicable.
The scoped implementation exists in the task worktree and the actual changed files are recorded in tasks.md.
Every behavior Phase is classified against its actual changed files; an unchanged route is recorded as such and a changed route includes its reason.
The Stage Agent directly uses the selected backend/frontend/fullstack testing package, or records why testing is not applicable for a material-only task.
The concrete testing strategy and task oracle run against the real worktree; commands, exit codes, limits, and outcomes are recorded as quality facts and in tasks.md.
The current diff is checked for scope and behavior, and the actual findings are recorded in tasks.md.
One independent findings review of the current change is recorded under quality/reviews/; unavailable stays honest and does not block same-task repair.
Every review finding has a disposition in tasks.md; valid findings are repaired before handoff.
The actual implementation and execution facts are current in the task worktree and tasks.md; no parallel implementation record is created.
tasks.md is marked completed only when actual changes, tests, AC evidence, and review dispositions support that claim; missing quality facts stay incomplete but do not block repair.
After all implementation tasks, the recorded final aggregate command runs once and its real exit, coverage limits, and per-AC trace are recorded; this does not claim provider review or pass.

Only after final tests and the AC trace, the existing phase_id=null integration review examines the current implementation; build-code closes only when no current actionable major/blocking finding has a valid evidence anchor, while unavailable, minor advice, and provider pass are kept distinct.

The Stage Agent gives a plain-language handoff covering what changed, how it works, final tests and AC trace, integration-review findings, remaining risks, and the next task; the comment is notification, not a gate.
